_about: Test questions for the SmartStock AI agent. The correct answers come from answer_key.sql (run against the ai.* views). {name} placeholders are filled from the answer key. 'keywords_any' is used when the answer key has no names/numbers for a question (for example: nothing is owed, so the agent should say so).
